slides.text: Human in the loop A workflow where AI chats do the jobs and you steer: each stage, its handoff and its check.

Human in the loop workflow The project-plan workflow: six stages from a vague task to a reviewed report, a fresh chat for each job, and you check every artifact in between. Read me What it shows The project-plan Workflow in its Stages view: six stages from a vague goal to a reviewed report, one card each. What to try Click a stage to open its Practice it window and copy its prompts into a fresh AI chat. Pick another use case in the toolbar. What to notice The checked mark on a card says a person reviews that result before the next stage starts. Presets (1/3) Page 1 of 3 Every job The same project plan, one level down: each stage holds its jobs, in the order they depend on each other. Read me What it shows The project-plan Workflow in its Jobs view: every job of every stage as a card, joined by arrows. What to try Click a job card to open its stage at exactly that job. Switch back to Stages in the toolbar and compare. What to notice Epics and Execute repeat: each is drawn once, inside a dashed bracket that says it runs once per epic or ticket. Use case : Plan a project Stages Jobs Demo mode High-level plan From a vague task to epics Gate 1 Describe the task Goal, audience, constraints, what done looks like checked Grill the scope At most three questions before any plan checked Plan the epics A short plan, one H3 per epic checked Epics Grill, then spec, once per epic × each epic (2) Grill the epic Questions first, in a fresh chat per epic checked Write the spec Goal, requirements, dependencies of one epic checked Requirements Merge specs, resolve conflicts, cut tickets Gate 2 Merge the specs One requirements document from all epic specs checked Resolve the overlap Dependencies and conflicts between the specs checked Cut the tickets Vertical slices, one H3 each checked Execute One fresh chat per ticket × each ticket (4) Run the ticket One fresh chat per ticket, with a numbers table checked Aggregate Results combined into one report Combine the results All ticket results in one document checked Write the report Summary, key figures, risks, open decisions checked Review The report as a page, then your sign-off Gate 3 Render the report The report as an HTML page with charts

Presets (2/3) Page 2 of 3 Another use case The same loop around a personal task: planning a week away for two. Read me What it shows The Vacation Workflow: four stages from an interview to a web page for your partner, with a check at each gate. What to try Open the Research stage, which repeats once per kind of stay. Use the Use case picker to switch back to the project plan. What to notice The stages and their checks are authored, not fixed: a different task gets different stages around the same idea. Use case : Plan personal vacation Stages Jobs Demo mode Practice it for Brief Brief Get interviewed, then sign off the requirements checked Gate 1 Practice it for Research Research Research 1 Research 2 Research 3 One fresh chat per kind of stay Practice it for Decide Decide Rank the stays, then you pick one checked Gate 2 Practice it for Page Page Your pick as a page for your partner

Presets (3/3) Page 3 of 3 In the command line The project plan for people who work in a terminal: prompts become commands. Read me What it shows The project-plan Workflow with the CLI toggle on, so every stage copies CLI setup and /skill commands instead of chat prompts. What to try Open a stage and copy its first command. Switch the CLI toggle off to go back to Chat and see the same step as a plain prompt. What to notice Only what a step copies changes. The stages, the checks and your place in the loop stay the same.
